name: Tactical Miscalculation
text:
**Tactical Miscalculation**

**School** enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; **Level** bard 2, hunter 2, inquisitor 2, ranger 2, skald 2
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
**Target** one creature
**Duration** 1 round/level
**Saving Throw** see text; **Spell Resistance** yes

The target becomes fixated on avoiding damage and fails to
 spot even the most opportune moments to attack. Whenever
 a creature the target threatens would provoke an attack of
 opportunity from the target, the target must succeed at a Will
 save or be unable to make the attack of opportunity against
 that creature.
